bullets.text: Fire department personnel are searching for two school boys who drowned in Puzhal lake, and the office should monitor the rescue operations.
The meteorological department issued an orange alert for heavy rain in Chennai and a yellow warning for Thiruvallur, and the office must stay alert.
National disaster response forces are ready as Chennai faces a red alert, and the office should watch the minister's updates from the spot.
Minister Dr. Kumar. Ra inspected pre-disaster arrangements in Velachery as the northeast monsoon began, and the office should track relief coordination.
Motorists face difficulties on Velachery Main Road near the TNPDCL office due to unrepaired dug-up portions, and the office should ensure quick road restoration.
Seeman demanded the withdrawal of the clinker grinding plant project in Tiruttani Karthikeyapuram, and the office should monitor environmental concerns raised there.
Avadi cybercrime police arrested a Delhi man for a boss scam involving a private company in Ambattur, and the office should watch cyber fraud cases.
Anbumani urged the Chief Minister to notify Pallikaranai marshland and make Chennai a Ramsar city, and the office should watch wetland conservation steps.
